An analysis of the company's financial profile reveals a highly leveraged balance sheet with a total debt-to-equity indicator implied by total liabilities of $45,596M against shareholders' equity of $25,838M, alongside a critical liquidity constraint evidenced by a current ratio of only 0.59 (current assets of $12,951M versus current liabilities of $21,864M). While the firm remains profitable with a net income of $665M and operating margin of 9% on $10,496M in revenue, the severe working capital deficit and substantial overall liabilities relative to its asset base ($71,487M) elevate default risk to the sub-investment grade category. Consequently, the firm's financial profile reflects moderate default risk characterized by speculative-grade credit metrics, warranting a BB rating.

DECISION: BB
